output.content: I checked the shadow deployment environment this morning and found it completely non functional. The pipeline stops before any traffic is routed to the shadow instance. There is no live shadow instance running in production. All model releases go directly to the primary serving endpoint without a parallel test phase. The CI/CD logs show the shadow deployment step is skipped entirely. No metrics are collected from a shadow environment because none exists. The current workflow relies solely on pre production unit tests and manual spot checks in staging. I observed zero automated traffic mirroring to a shadow cluster during the last five deployment cycles. The infrastructure configuration for shadow deployment is absent from the active pipeline definition.
